correctness.rationale: The rank-r map coordinates by interval partitions A and images B have p=binom(n-1,r-1) rows and q=binom(n,r) columns. Mutual inverse iff cross-transversality, so K(X)=R X^T R. The incidence matrix R has a unit triangular p-column minor indexed by the right endpoints; its SVD splits each i=j diagonal into a positive lambda_i, each i<j pair into +/-sqrt(lambda_i lambda_j), and leaves p(q-p) zeros. In rank 2 the Gram entries min(i,j)(n-max(i,j)) invert to n times the Dirichlet path Laplacian; in rank n-1 Gram is the path tridiagonal (2,1). These exact proofs cover n=1 and r=n and do not claim a closed intermediate-rank trigonometric spectrum. Independent computations checked all 20 strata n=2..6, row rank/inertia and both boundary Gram spectra; numerical checks only corroborate the proof.
residual_risks: No assertion of infinite truth rests solely on finite computation.
